call_input.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: one Korean online recruitment poster, a single flat square 1:1 image.
Primary request: Fictional neighbor repair workshop participation invitation. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Content idea: Participation depends on inspection, possible repair, component costs and photo consent. Let these exact supplied conditions do the main visual work. This is a condition-led editorial invitation, not a large title followed by a hero image followed by an application footer.

Concrete composition: Build an open asymmetric two-column editorial page on a clean white ground with charcoal-black text. The narrower left column begins with a measured title, about the visual size of a publication title rather than a full-width masthead, then its supplied recruitment subtitle. Put the COMPLETE application sentence immediately below that subtitle, early in the reading path, as ordinary clearly legible text with a bold deadline and a continuous easily found URL. It may wrap once between the Korean phrase and the complete URL; never split the URL or put it in a colored panel. Below that, group the appointment date and time, location and eligibility as practical attendance facts. Put the supplied inquiry line nearby in that same reading path.

The wider right column is the main condition-reading field. Start near the top with the FULL non-guarantee sentence in strong medium-large type, allowing comfortable word-boundary wrapping so that it reads as the central proposition rather than fine print. Relate the supplied-tools/component-cost sentence closely beneath it as the inspection-and-cost group. A second group pairs the bring-one-item sentence with the prohibition sentence. A third group pairs photography consent and participation fee/payment. Separate these actual semantic groups by deliberate whitespace only. Do not invent group headings, labels, numbers, checks, arrows, bullets or explanatory copy. Use relative weight and spacing instead of cards or panels. All full sentences remain plainly readable; the longest condition must be comfortably readable in a 720px-wide view, with body type equivalent to at least roughly 19–20px at that view. Reserve adequate line length and line spacing rather than compressing condition text. No wide headline, no bottom orange application CTA, no stacked hero-and-footer arrangement.

Modest actual inspection photograph: In the lower portion of the narrower left area, include a compact credible photograph of exactly one unbranded frayed household canvas bag awaiting inspection, with a simple black-handled magnifying lens resting on its loose handle-attachment seam. The bag and magnifier are enough: no needle, no thread mechanism, no other tools or generic tool decoration. The lens makes the seam the point of inspection; do not depict a repaired or triumphant completed result. Clear canvas weave, loose existing seam threads and intact larger bag construction. Magnifier rim and handle actually rest on the fabric with consistent short contact shadows under soft overhead daylight; no floating or merged geometry. Keep this photograph modest and subordinate to the condition-reading field. Natural canvas material and black lens provide subject specificity; the rest is clean flat typography. The photograph has a quiet clean boundary, not a card, collage, illustration, icon, product label or mockup. Preserve generous clear margins and prevent text/photo collisions.

Typography: Sober contemporary Korean sans serif. Correct and consistent word spaces, sharply legible syllable strokes, deliberate alignments and line spacing. The title is smaller than an oversized masthead; condition emphasis and an early application position determine hierarchy. Do not stylize punctuation or introduce decorative tracking in the compact compound “전기·배터리”: the middle dot touches the two words at normal punctuation spacing with NO additional word spaces. Preserve the en dash in the time range and the comma in the fee. Apply clean high contrast, not texture or display effects.

Printable copy — the following fourteen items appear exactly ONCE, as the only printable words. Do not print prompt labels or quotation delimiters. Preserve spelling, word spaces, numbers, punctuation and symbols exactly. Semantic regrouping and wrapping at natural word boundaries are allowed; no rewritten or shortened sentences:
고쳐 쓰는 토요일
이웃 수리 작업실 참여자 모집
2026년 12월 5일 토요일
오후 2시–5시 · 입장은 오후 1시 40분부터
하람시 잇는집 2층 · 수선길 12
대상: 만 16세 이상 · 회차별 12명
작은 생활용품 한 점을 가져와 주세요.
전기·배터리 제품과 위험한 물건은 받지 않습니다.
도구는 제공하며 부품 비용은 현장에서 안내합니다.
수리 여부는 상태 확인 후 결정하며 완성을 보장하지 않습니다.
촬영은 동의한 참여자에 한해 진행합니다.
참가비 5,000원 · 현장 결제
12월 2일까지 신청: haram-mend.example/join
문의: 이웃 수리 운영팀

Constraints: Exactly one independent flat square poster, not panels, contact sheet or mockup. No duplicate or missing copy, no invented event facts, logos, badges, icons, borders, frames, slogans, numbering, watermarks or decorative microtype. No electric/battery or hazardous brought item. No repair guarantee. All fourteen exact items, including conditional statements, exclusions, fees, consent, deadline and full address, must be visible with good contrast and readable at screen usage size.

residuals: Left-column practical copy is smaller than intended minimum but readable at inspected 720px; not comfortable at 320px.
Full URL is clear at native and 720px but not comfortably verifiable at 320px.
Time-range separator Unicode identity cannot be proven from raster pixels.
Two-column composition allows multiple scan orders.
